title: M4RI-style invert path for BitMatrix
description:
GF(2) BitMatrix invert (Gauss-Jordan over the bitwise tail-masked path) underperforms M4RI's specialised invert at n=64,256,1024. Aggregate ratios in dev/bench_results/2026-05-08-2cfc4372-sota-scorecard.md § 2.3 show 5x-15x gap depending on n.

## Background

The 974a85bd (GF(2) BitMatrix story) closed at story scope but did not include invert as a hard target. Per epic 97bf0879 umbrella amendment A8 (Wave-12 close-cascade), the 3 GF(2) invert FAIL cells need a named successor. M4RI's mzd_invert_m4ri uses the M4RM gather-tables structure on the working RREF; gf2-core does plain Gauss-Jordan.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Implement an M4RM-table-augmented invert path in BitMatrix (or document why gf2-core's existing invert is structurally beyond catch-up).
- [hard] If the implementation lands, GF(2) invert at n in {64, 256, 1024} comes within 1.5x of M4RI mzd_invert_m4ri.
- [hard] Bit-exact equality with the existing reference invert; no regression on existing tests.
- [hard] Filed under epic 97bf0879 umbrella amendment A8 as the named follow-up for the 3 GF(2) invert FAIL cells.
